newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Electronics says planning November IPO.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Electronics says planning November IPO.

text.p: Semiconductor and electronic goods manufacturer Hyundai Electronics Industrial Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Hyundai Group, plans an initial public offering for November, a company official said on Wednesday.
"We will file an application with the Securities Supervisory Board on September 2," the official said. "Further details will be available two weeks later."
Hyundai Electronics earlier said it planned to offer 19.7 million new shares to the public in July 1996 in a bid to increase its capital to 354.8 billion won from 230 billion.
Under South Korean securities regulations, 20 percent of the shares will go to Hyundai Electroncis' employees and the rest will be offered to the public.
Currently, Hyundai Group units hold a combined 77 percent stake in Hyundai Electronics, the official said.
Hyundai Engineering and Construction is the largest shareholder with a 25.43 percent stake, followed by Hyundai Merchant Marine Co with 24.08 percent.
Hyundai Electronics appointed LG Securities to lead-manage the offering.
